plan.title: 2x2 treatment-by-timepoint interaction DE + pathways
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question — does the treatment effect differ between t0 and t1 — is an interaction test on a 2 (condition) x 2 (time) factorial design with n=3 per cell (12 samples total), raw Salmon gene counts (12000 genes x 12 samples in counts.csv, metadata.csv carries condition/time/time_hours). The design step fits DESeq2 with ~condition + time + condition:time on all 12 samples, tests the interaction coefficient as the primary answer to 'does treatment effect differ by time', and reports the simple treatment effects within t0 and within t1 alongside it, per the DESeq2 interaction-analysis convention. With 3 replicates per cell the interaction term (a difference-of-differences) is materially underpowered — the QC and DE steps state this explicitly and do not compensate by loosening thresholds. LFC shrinkage uses ashr because the interaction/simple-effect contrasts are not single model coefficients. Downstream, fgsea preranked GSEA runs per contrast (interaction, simple effect at t0, simple effect at t1) against MSigDB Hallmark (2026.1, staged locally) with Reactome and WikiPathways human collections as follow-up passes, ranked on the DESeq2 Wald statistic. All steps are grounded against the Inflexa procedure for this exact situation (4 cells, n=3, interaction=true, human, salmon counts), which was validated with execute_knowledge_check (ok:true after correcting the initially-flagged enrichment method reference).
